title: Heavenly Father’s Lamb
old_p1: Long ago, Abraham told his son Isaac, “Heavenly Father will give us a lamb.” Later, the Lord told His people to choose a perfect lamb.
Those lambs were a picture of Jesus, Heavenly Father’s perfect Son.
The night Jesus was born, shepherds near Bethlehem were watching their sheep. A shepherd keeps sheep and lambs safe.
old_p2: An angel, Heavenly Father’s messenger, came, and bright light shone all around. The shepherds were afraid. The angel said, “Fear not! I bring good news of great joy. A Savior is born!” A Savior saves us. Years later, John the Baptist said of Jesus, “Look! Heavenly Father’s Lamb!”
Jesus is Heavenly Father’s Lamb, sent to save us. Tonight, rest snug and safe, like a little lamb.
p1: Long ago, Abraham told Isaac that Heavenly Father would give a lamb. Later, Heavenly Father asked His people for perfect lambs.
Those lambs were a picture. They pointed to Jesus, Heavenly Father’s perfect Son.
The night Jesus was born, shepherds near Bethlehem were keeping their sheep safe.
p2: Suddenly an angel came, and bright light shone all around. The shepherds were afraid. The angel said, “Fear not! I bring you good news of great joy. A Savior is born!” Years later, John the Baptist said of Jesus, “Look, the Lamb of God!”
Jesus is Heavenly Father’s Lamb, sent to save us. When you feel afraid, remember: “Fear not!” Rest snug and safe, like a little lamb.
